groups.instruction: Which comment does John make about each of the following photography magazines? Choose SIX answers from the box and write the correct letter, A-H, next to questions 11-16. Comments
Choose TWO letters, A-E. Which TWO useful features of the Photo Safari tour does John mention?
Choose TWO letters, A-E. Which TWO opinions does John give about his holiday with Photo Safari?

options.t: Good advice was given about what clothes to take.
There were photo opportunities every day.
The non-photographers had a good time.
It was the best time of year to see the animals.
The guides knew a lot about photography.
